subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The heads turned to the back, where Dr. Pfizer, surrounded by the female troupe of dancers, beamed with exhilaration in a __dazzling__ ocean-green dress paired with stunning jewellery.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 — Lackluster**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"exhilaration"** means a feeling of great happiness, excitement, or joy. **(अत्यधिक खुशी / उत्साह)**

 
 
• **Example:** She felt exhilaration after winning the gold medal.
 
 
 
• **"Lackluster"** means dull, without energy, excitement, or brightness. **(फीका / नीरस)**
 
 
• **Example:** The team gave a lackluster performance in the final match.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"exhilaration"** is **"lackluster"**, which shows absence of excitement or enthusiasm.

Therefore, the correct answer is — **Option 2 (Lackluster)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Pristine** (निर्मल / बिल्कुल साफ): Something that is in its original and perfect condition.

 
 
• **Example:** The beach remained pristine and untouched.
 
 
 
• **Gingerly** (सावधानी से): In a careful or cautious manner.
 
 
• **Example:** He gingerly picked up the broken glass.
 
 
 
• **Luminous** (चमकदार / प्रकाशमान): Giving off light; shining brightly.
 
 
• **Example:** The moon looked luminous in the night sky.
